usedFor: api.video starts the work with “Live Stream Ended”, and HubSpot records it through “Add Notes to Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Live Stream Ended” in api.video, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: The action takes a note date and body, so each finished stream leaves a dated line on a contact.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, so decide where that value comes from first.
